A.grid: 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 icons, read left to right then top to bottom
A.prompt:
Fantasy strategy game spell icons in the same rich painterly pixel-art style as the reference image: high detail, crisp pixel clusters, dramatic lighting, saturated magic glow, one clear focal subject per icon, readable even when shrunk to 48 pixels. Each icon is a square scene filling its frame, with a thin bevelled frame in the color of its magic realm (chaos: fiery red-orange; nature: emerald green; sorcery: bright blue; death: violet-purple; life: warm gold; arcane: silver-grey). Lay the icons out exactly like the reference: a grid on a flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, every icon the same size, evenly spaced with a clear magenta gap between them, nothing touching the image edge. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark.

Layout: 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 icons, read left to right then top to bottom.

1. (chaos realm frame) a straight line of three roaring pillars of fire erupting from a grassy battlefield like a burning curtain, a foot soldier recoiling from the heat.
2. (chaos realm frame) glowing red runic fire mines half buried in the dirt of a battlefield, one of them exploding in a fireball under an armored boot.
3. (chaos realm frame) a jagged red-and-white lightning bolt leaping in a chain from one armored soldier to a second and a third, each struck figure lit up.
4. (chaos realm frame) a knight wrapped in a swirling shield of flames, the sword of an attacker turning red-hot and scorching the attacker.
5. (nature realm frame) a warrior caught in heavy slow motion, emerald vines and glowing amber hourglass sand dragging at his legs.
6. (nature realm frame) a whole marching column of soldiers bogged down by glowing green vines and streams of amber hourglass sand.
7. (nature realm frame) a shimmering translucent wall of green-gold force standing across a stone bridge, an enemy soldier bouncing off it.
8. (arcane realm frame) a tall silver-blue arched magic portal standing on a road, showing through it a friendly walled city, soldiers stepping through.
